"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This brief public window onto the consequences of three decades of punitive social policy will not by itself reverse the funneling of tax benefits to the rich.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The funneling of tax benefits to the rich can only be overturned by a political defeat of “trickle down” economics revived under Bush.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Only the rebirth of a majoritarian democratic Left, aware of the Right’s use of racism to divide a potential progressive majority, can give rise to accountable government programs necessary to provide all communities with high-quality public health care, housing, education, and infrastructure development.",
